notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug with the seed history that put the game into a bad state on the player's first play through. Not exactly a welcoming experience. Sorry about that!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's movement indicator was hidden by the time bubble, making it hard to see where you were going.

[/list]
